Ice Cream - You Suck at Cooking  #icecream #recipes

This is was soo easy to make and no need for ice churner  Ice cream ingredients  •1 cup whipped cream (powder or liquid) •1½ cups very cold evaporated milk •½ cup thick fruit of your choice puree •½ cup cookie crumbs •Optional: 1–2 tbsp sugar,if you want it sweeter ice cream  How to make it  1. Whip the base properly 	•Pour cold evaporated milk into a bowl with whipped cream powder ( if you are using powder)  	•Add whip cream into a bowl and whip gradually until very stiff peaks form 2. Prepare the fruits puree 	•If your fruit is naturally sweet, use as it is 3. Folding gently add some puree into whipped cream and milk mixture 	•Fold slowly (don’t mix hard or it will go watery) 4. Add cookie crumbs 	•Fold in crumbs at the end 	•Save some for topping if you want crunch layers Freezing method  Step 1 	•	Freeze for 1–2 hours Step 2 (important trick) 	•	Take it out and stir or lightly whip again and add more cookies crumbs and the rest of the fruit pure. 	•	This breaks ice crystals and improves smoothness of the ice cream. Step 3 	•	Freeze again for 6/8 hours 	•	Use very cold evaporated milk (not room temp) 	•	Whip until very stiff peaks (don’t underwhip) 	•	Keep the puree thick it Remix once during freezing (this makes a big difference)  Enjoy ice 🍨 #recipesforyou #icecreamlover #fyp #summertreats
